screen7-a1.description: top-left of the profile sheet over a dark banner (records call it Back
screen7-a1.visible_text: none (X glyph on the dark banner, top-left)
screen7-a1.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Back"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen7-a1.convention_relied_on: X = close; my reading, confidence high
screen7-a1.initial_rationale: unlabeled close convention; exemption pending the tap

test_cases.observed_result: the profile sheet closed and the Messages view returned

screen7-a1.deciding_evidence: the X closed the profile sheet, matching the convention

screen7-a2.glyph: rounded mascot face with two eyes on a blue circle
screen7-a2.visible_text: none (large round avatar with a green dot)
screen7-a2.convention_relied_on: avatar = your profile picture / view profile; my reading, confidence medium
screen7-a2.initial_rationale: unlabeled avatar; convention suggests viewing or changing the picture; exemption pending the tap

test_cases.expected_result: the picture opens or a way to change it appears
test_cases.confirms_if: something unrelated to the picture happens
test_cases.observed_result: a bottom sheet 'Change Online Status' opened (Online/Idle/Do Not Disturb/Invisible, 'Set a custom status')

screen7-a2.deciding_evidence: the avatar changes online status, which neither the picture convention nor anything visible (only a tiny green dot) predicts
screen7-a2.recommendation: put a visible caption such as 'Status: Online' next to the dot, or make the dot itself a labeled status control

screen7-a3.description: status bubble with a plus-in-circle glyph and an italic prompt
screen7-a3.visible_text: italic prompt "What have you been reading?" with a plus-in-circle glyph (wording rotates between visits)
screen7-a3.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Add custom status"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen7-a3.initial_rationale: a question in italics does not say it sets a status; the wording changes on each visit

test_cases.confirms_if: the screen that opens reveals a purpose the bubble never named
test_cases.overturns_if: the bubble's own words named what opens
test_cases.observed_result: a 'Set your status' screen opened with a Status field and 'Clear at: Tomorrow'; the bubble's prompt changed between visits ('Just finished reading...', 'What have you been playing?')

screen7-a3.deciding_evidence: the bubble sets a custom status but only the destination says so; its rotating question never names status
screen7-a3.recommendation: prefix a fixed label, e.g. 'Set status: What have you been reading?'

screen7-a4.description: display name with a down chevron
screen7-a4.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Accessibility Testing"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen7-a4.initial_rationale: a name with a chevron reads as an account dropdown; nothing says what it opens

test_cases.confirms_if: a control unrelated to the name opens
test_cases.observed_result: the same 'Change Online Status' sheet as the avatar opened

screen7-a4.deciding_evidence: the display name opens an online-status chooser; nothing on the name conveys status
screen7-a4.recommendation: show the status next to the name with a label ('Online ▾ change status') so the chevron belongs to something named

screen7-a5.description: filled button with a pencil glyph
screen7-a5.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Edit Profile"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen7-a5.initial_rationale: the words say what it does
screen7-a5.deciding_evidence: visible text names the action; no test required

screen7-a6.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Main"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen7-a6.initial_rationale: a tab paired with 'Wishlist'; switching the panel is the purpose

test_cases.confirms_if: nothing happens or something else opens
test_cases.observed_result: the default profile panel (offer card, Orbs, Member Since, Friends, Note) returned

screen7-a6.deciding_evidence: the tab switched back to the default profile panel

screen7-a7.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Wishlist"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict

test_cases.confirms_if: it opens something that is not a wishlist
test_cases.observed_result: the tab showed 'No hearts yet', 'Browse the Shop and heart the items you love to add them here.' and an 'Add Item' button

screen7-a7.deciding_evidence: the tab showed a wishlist with a plain explanation of what goes in it; the everyday word held

screen7-a8.description: top-right of the 'Amp up your profile' card
screen7-a8.visible_text: none (X at the top-right of the 'Amp up your profile' card)
screen7-a8.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Dismiss offer"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen7-a8.convention_relied_on: X = dismiss/close; my reading, confidence high
screen7-a8.initial_rationale: close convention on a card; exemption pending the tap

test_cases.precondition: profile sheet with the offer card
test_cases.action: tap the X on the card
test_cases.observed_result: the 'Amp up your profile' card disappeared and the rows below moved up

screen7-a8.deciding_evidence: the X dismissed the card, as the convention promises

screen7-a9.description: button in the 'Amp up your profile' card
screen7-a9.visible_text: "Get Nitro" with a Nitro glyph, in the card 'Amp up your profile'
screen7-a9.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Get Nitro"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen7-a9.initial_rationale: 'Nitro' is a product name; nothing says it is a paid subscription

test_cases.precondition: profile sheet with the offer card
test_cases.expected_result: a plain description of what Nitro is before any purchase
test_cases.confirms_if: a subscription/pricing page opens that the label did not predict
test_cases.overturns_if: the label's words predicted what opened
test_cases.observed_result: a 'Discord NITRO' page opened: 'NITRO $9.99 / month', 'NITRO BASIC $2.99 / month', perk lists and 'Get Nitro' / 'Get Basic' buttons

screen7-a9.deciding_evidence: the button leads to a monthly paid subscription; the label is a brand name that conveys neither the purchase nor what it buys
screen7-a9.recommendation: name the action plainly, e.g. 'Subscribe to Nitro ($9.99/month)' or 'See paid upgrades'

screen7-a10.description: button in the 'Amp up your profile' card
screen7-a10.visible_text: "Shop" with a storefront glyph, in the card 'Amp up your profile'
screen7-a10.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Shop"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen7-a10.initial_rationale: 'Shop' under 'Amp up your profile' says what it is

test_cases.precondition: profile sheet with the offer card
test_cases.confirms_if: something other than a shop opens
test_cases.observed_result: a 'Shop' page opened with profile decoration bundles and an Orbs balance

screen7-a11.visible_text: "Orbs Balance" (value still loading: three faint dots)
screen7-a11.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Orbs balance: Loading, busy"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen7-a11.initial_rationale: 'Orbs' is product jargon; a balance row does not say what pressing it does

test_cases.confirms_if: it opens something the row did not name
test_cases.observed_result: a 'Quests' page opened with a sheet 'Watch. Earn Orbs. Get Rewards. Complete quick video Bounties to collect Orbs and spend them in the Shop.'

screen7-a11.deciding_evidence: a row labeled as a balance opens a sponsored-video Quests page; 'Orbs' is never explained before the tap
screen7-a11.recommendation: say what orbs are and what the row opens, e.g. 'Orbs (reward points): 0 — earn more by watching videos'

screen7-a12.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Friends"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
screen7-a12.initial_rationale: the word and chevron say it opens the friends list
screen7-a12.deciding_evidence: visible text names the destination; no test required

screen7-a14.description: bottom bar item: glyph with the word 'Quests' under it and a red dot
screen7-a14.visible_text: "Quests" under a glyph, with a red dot
screen7-a14.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "Quests, new"; talkback_label (same) — used only to know what to watch for when tapping; not used in the verdict
